iterations.result: Built and shipped. User found stick lines unnatural regardless of proportions. Superseded.
SUPERSEDED. Built fine but read as a bathroom sign / icon, not a mascot. User: 'image of a human is terrible.'

iterations.approach: Potted plant drawn with filled SwiftUI Canvas paths (zero deps)
iterations.result: DONE. Build green, 8/8 tests pass, upright + wilt both verified on simulator.
iterations.rationale: Literal humans drawn in code always look cheap. A plant is forgiving (organic curves can't look 'broken'), keeps warm living-companion feel, maps posture perfectly. User picked plant over abstract-spine, breathing-orb, Lottie.
iterations.craft_fix: Filled tapered Paths, not hairline strokes — solid shapes read as designed, strokes read as wireframe.

implementation.pot: filled terracotta trapezoid 0xC98A5B + rim 0xB87A4C + soil ellipse 0x4A3B2E
implementation.stem: tapered filled path (offset quad-curves), tip leans +0.16x / +0.22y at full wilt
implementation.leaves: 3 almond leaves (two quad curves), sag up to ~40deg with slouch
implementation.sway: rotation +/-1.6deg at pot base, 4.5s loop, reduced-motion aware
implementation.resting: foliage opacity 0.55 + extra 0.18 droop, sway off
